failure.title: Expo-web reverse proxy rewrote a same-origin request to a different canonical host
failure.note: The client session journey retained its trace and error context after a browser-same-origin POST received HTTP 403 at the reverse-proxied API boundary.
failure.diagnosis: The browser submitted to 127.0.0.1:8081, while the static-web proxy rewrote upstream traffic to 127.0.0.1 on the API port. Next standalone canonicalized its own origin as localhost, so the shared fail-closed origin check correctly rejected the mismatched harness request.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
